note: Hand-maintained. Enter each département's new order every August/September (spec S368 §4.1). Dates are inclusive. Weekdays are ISO (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday). The page works out today's state; python3 qw_rules.py --check validates this file.

levels.battue: drives with dogs (big game); the main danger to walkers
levels.open: general shooting season: every mode of hunting
levels.stalk: stalking or hides only (approche/affût), no dogs
levels.suspended: a weekday on which the order suspends shooting

weights.note: Starting values from the spec (§4.1), to tune in B5. chasse value = wood x woodland[level] + (1 - wood) x open_land[level], 0-1.
weights.stale_rules: treat every day as battue and show 'règles de chasse non mises à jour pour cette saison'

public_holidays.note: France (metropolitan), for the 'except public holidays' day rules. Easter 2027 is 28 March.

notes: No day of the week is closed to hunting: every day in season is a hunting day.
Hare: some EPG are Sunday-only (niveau 2); not used here (small game, open land).
Art. 6: in forêts domaniales the hunting days are set by the lot clauses (ONF calendars).
Boar destruction on prefectoral authorisation 1-31 March 2027 (71-2026-06-17-00003); inside the battue period anyway.

periods.what: ASSUMED (S372, ruling H3): summer deer stalking and boar on prefectoral authorisation, set by a separate order not seen. Pattern from the 2024 Rhône consultation: boar 1 June-14 Aug in battue/affût/approche on authorisation.
ouverture générale, chasse à tir (art. 2.1); chevreuil, cerf, daim same dates (art. 5.1)
ASSUMED (S372, ruling H3): boar crop-protection shooting on authorisation, separate order not seen.

day_rules.what: Chasse à tir suspendue le mardi et le vendredi, sauf jours fériés (art. 3). Does NOT apply to chevreuil, cerf, daim, sanglier, so drives can still happen: no change to the walker's risk.

notes: Outside 13 Sept-28 Feb (deer) and 13 Sept-31 Mar (boar), separate prefectoral orders set summer stalking and extra boar hunting (art. 5.1). S372 could not find the 2026 order, so those months are entered as 'stalk', marked assumed (ruling H3). Replace with the real order when found (likely DDT-2026-A4x, rhone.gouv.fr).
Hours: one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset (Lyon) (art. 4).

periods.what: ouverture générale de la chasse à tir (art. 1)
sanglier, protection des semis, affût/approche, battue à titre exceptionnel (art. 2, art. 6)

day_rules.what: Chasse à tir et au vol suspendues le mardi et le vendredi, sauf jours fériés (art. 4). Exceptions: enclosures, commercial shoots, pest species without dogs, pigeon hides 1 Oct-11 Nov.

notes: Art. 4 gives no date limits, so the Tuesday/Friday suspension is applied to every period above.
Chasse à courre 15 Sept 2026-31 Mar 2027 runs every day (hounds, no shooting); not scored.

onf.note: ONF state-forest (forêt domaniale) hunt days, keyed by ONF id (iidtn_frt). Typed in each September from onf.fr/chasse/les-calendriers-de-chasse-en-foret-domaniale.
